jobId.title: Job ID
jobId.description: LinkedIn numeric job identifier (extracted from job URL or base-card URN).

title.title: Title
title.description: Job title as shown in the posting.

companyUrl.title: Company URL
companyUrl.description: Link to the company page when available.

location.title: Location
location.description: Job location string as provided on LinkedIn.

salary.title: Salary
salary.description: Compensation information when included in the listing.

seniority.title: Seniority
seniority.description: Job seniority/level when provided (e.g., Senior, Mid).

postedAt.title: Posted at
postedAt.description: Date or relative time when the job was posted.

descriptionText.title: Description (text)
descriptionText.description: Plain-text job description extracted from the page.

descriptionHtml.title: Description (HTML)
descriptionHtml.description: HTML of the job description to preserve formatting.

collectedAt.title: Scraped at
collectedAt.description: Timestamp when this item was scraped by the actor.

searchQuery.title: Search query
searchQuery.description: The keyword used to find this job during the run.

searchLocation.title: Search location
searchLocation.description: The location filter applied during the run.
